title: Discover
discoveryOff: Discovery is off. Turn it on in Deep profile or Privacy, then reload.
needAuthBody: Sign in to see suggestions from public profiles and record interest or pass.
emptyBody: No profiles match your current filters. You can complete your profile, adjust criteria, or check back later.
mutualToast: Mutual match — chat is open. Our Space is created only after both people accept an invitation.
pageIntro: Explained suggestions from data you choose to share — not a love probability. A mutual like opens chat and does not create Our Space.
flagOffBody: The feature is disabled by a feature flag / kill switch.
